members.name: key
members.doc: Stable identity. A segment whose key survives a data change keeps its place and color, so switching datasets morphs the arcs.

members.name: color
members.doc: Any CSS color. Segments default to the shared --series-* palette in data order, then neutral steps.

types.name: DonutChartProps
types.doc: Use a donut chart for a few parts of one whole, when the share of each part matters more than precise comparison.

members.name: label
members.doc: What the whole is, such as "Visits by source". Names the chart for assistive technology.

members.name: totalLabel
members.doc: Center label at rest, above the total.

members.name: size
members.doc: Diameter in pixels. The chart scales down to fit narrower containers.

members.name: groupBelow
members.doc: Segments below this share of the total join "Other".

members.name: maxSegments
members.doc: The most segments drawn, counting "Other". The smallest parts beyond it are grouped.

members.name: activeKey
members.doc: Controlled selected segment key. Hover and focus preview other segments without changing it.

members.name: hiddenKeys
members.doc: Controlled hidden segment keys. A hidden segment closes and the rest of the ring redistributes.

members.name: legendAction
members.doc: What clicking a legend row does: show or hide its segment, or pin it as the selected segment.

members.name: legend
members.doc: The synced legend beside or below the ring.
